label: Clean phone-recording blog FAQ claims - July 23, 2026

faqs.question: Do I need a special camera to record a football match?
faqs.answer: No dedicated camera is required for Pitchside's phone-first workflow. You still need suitable footage, a safe mounting position and enough visibility for the important playing area.

faqs.question: How do I record a 5-a-side match?
faqs.answer: Record in landscape from a safe, stable position with as much of the pitch in frame as possible. Smaller pitches can often work with one raised phone, but you should record a short test clip before kickoff and check for blind spots.

faqs.question: How can I turn match footage into highlights and stats?
faqs.answer: Pitchside is in private beta and is testing supported stats and highlights from suitable phone-recorded footage. Detected events and player assignments should be reviewed before treating the match record as final.

faqs.question: Is 1080p at 60fps always the right setting?
faqs.answer: No. Higher resolution and frame rate can improve detail, but they also use more battery and storage. Test your own phone and check Pitchside Product Status for current input guidance.

faqs.question: Can one phone capture the whole pitch?
faqs.answer: One phone can work well on some smaller pitches, but it does not guarantee complete coverage. Two phones may help when a single view leaves goal areas, corners or far-side action hidden.
